ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering SNAP Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent cases of SNAP fraud in Minnesota, including the $1.1 million scheme involving Abdidwahid Mohamed.
questions: How widespread is SNAP fraud in Minnesota?
What measures are being taken to prevent SNAP fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of fraud in government programs. By following the money and investigating the recent cases of SNAP fraud, we may be able to identify vulnerabilities in the system and highlight the need for increased oversight.
